question.problem:
$$
{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,2)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{5}, & x=5 \\ \frac{3}{5}, & x=10 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=2]$ given that the conditional probability mass function ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,2)$ is shown above and the corresponding conditional expected value is ${\mu }_{X|2}=8.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $X$ given $Y=y$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=y] & =\text{E}[(X-{\mu }_{X|y})^{2}\,|\,Y=y] \\  & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2} \\  & =[{\sum }_{x}{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=y] & =[{\sum }_{x}{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,2)]-{\mu }_{X|2}^{2} \\  & =[(5)^{2}\cdot \frac{2}{5}+(10)^{2}\cdot \frac{3}{5}]-(8)^{2} \\  & =10+60-64 \\  & =6.\end{aligned}
$$
